VBO:0200390.summary: A coydog can be wary of people yet lively with toys when undisturbed. Wildfire, a rescued coyote–dog cross, gradually grew more confident after arriving at a sanctuary in early 2024. His caretakers describe him tossing toys when he thinks no one is watching, while remaining reserved around humans.
VBO:0200390.shortDescription: Coydogs are coyote–dog crosses; Wildfire's own story shows wary reserve alongside exuberant private toy play.
